attribution: Local final working-tree runs based on the baseline; LF-normalized hashes bind 50 source files to the containing checkpoint. No remote CI, deployment or production runtime is claimed.

engineering_review.scope: Writer serialization/fingerprints, actual row waits, bounded retry rollback, non-enabling import write set, runtime/importer/fixture privilege separation, fixed-schema live trigger health and additive migration retry handling.

LB01.scope: Existing complete fictional prefix/tail plan; actual import yields three, preserves fixed clocks and legacy state, no grant/epoch.

LB02.scope: Rerun offline positive-origin zero versus missing-prefix unknown.

LB03.scope: Rerun offline incompleteness; applying incomplete source has whole-database zero-write verification.

LB05.scope: Rerun immutable conflict checks; actual conflicting input/stored immutable expiry rejected with whole-database state unchanged.

LB07.scope: Rerun unknown ender/time/deadline and invalid policy/anchor checks.

LB08.scope: Actual identical retry, catalogued JSON reordering/reformatting, duplicate copies and new-key alias return one receipt without repeated effects; changed valid intent conflicts.

LB09.scope: Rerun overlap proof; actual equivalent source/native identities persist three raw facts/one equivalence but count one request beyond the prefix. Retry has no effects; fresh current bundle stages zero repeated facts.

LB10.scope: Rerun unexplained four/explained five; actual overlapping floor is three, not four.

LB11.scope: Retained four L02d fault stages plus actual 1213/1205 rollback, bounded three-attempt exhaustion and subsequent safe retry on both final profiles. Contracted pair/fact/key/receipt state is atomic; no duplicate effects.

LB12.scope: Retained committed-result loss/status recovery; final import rerun preserves once-only receipt semantics. Genuine engine retries commit one receipt/fact set, never uncertain blind replay.

LB13.scope: PASS for supported synthetic target: actual native request on another pair shares sender global allowance; actual target cancellation/ending HTTP writers invalidate stale import plans. Both real HTTP/importer orderings preserve newer tail/budgets/versions. Import target stays legacy_incomplete and cannot send a new request.

LB14.scope: Actual block, report attachment and versioned reviewer-clearance HTTP races on both profiles, including unchanged pair-version changes, reject stale intent or preserve current restriction. PARTIAL: physical cleanup/purge overlap remains NOT RUN under L03.

LB15.scope: Actual account-deletion SQL waits on importer rows; sessions advance and account/history access remain denied after commit and metadata-only receipt replay. PARTIAL: ban and consent-withdrawal writer workflows inside apply NOT RUN.

LB16.scope: Real route checks preserve two-ending cutoff, incomplete legacy refusal, approved chat on unmatch, personal blocks and exact live clearance/creator removal. PARTIAL: unsupported historical consent/restoration/review proof families remain INCOMPLETE, no activation adapter.

LB17.scope: Actual report/duplicate-report mixed races preserve attribution, one incident/probation effect and immutable active deadline; imports create no report/finding/ban/probation. PARTIAL: historical report/probation proof application profile remains unsupported/NOT RUN.

LB18.scope: Rerun global-window/probation coverage gap stays incomplete.

LB19.scope: Rerun missing-writer/boundary/tail/quiescence checks. Actual deployed writers/cutover and long-transaction capture UNVERIFIED.

LB20.scope: Rerun synthetic committed-tail union. Actual snapshot/change-stream, deletion and long-transaction observation NOT RUN.

LB21.scope: Original default-deny/zero-write checks rerun; 8 additional PDO-disabled barrier assertions and explicit hook refusal confirm local disposable/test gates. Ordinary authorized synthetic import works with test controls disabled.

LB22.scope: Rerun bounded parser suite plus actual malformed duplicate-key/unsupported input with whole-database zero writes and pure forged-plan rejection.

LB23.scope: Rerun raw bytes/custody/scope/proof mismatch checks; bytes revalidated before connection. Real custody/signer authenticity UNVERIFIED.

LB24.scope: Offline path remains isolated/read-only and deterministic. SQL read-only planner adapter is absent; its missing-ledger/SQL-identity variant NOT RUN.

LB25.scope: Rerun original expiry tests; source valid at plan time but expired at server-time apply rejects with zero writes. Physical staging/detail purge and compaction NOT RUN.

LB26.scope: Original clocks/native metadata preserved; imported private facts cannot mint an ordinary report proof; affected closed-text regression passes. Full import/media/new-segment/cleanup race NOT RUN.

LB27.scope: Actual missing fact/receipt/key frontier and corrupt receipt fail closed. Independent stale-restore/deletion/consent replay NOT RUN; co-located counts are not restore proof.

LB28.scope: Five distinct CLI PID/connection rendezvous scenarios; same/different keys, conflicting intents/bundles and fresh-state rejection. No HTTP overlap claim.

LB29.scope: 17 actual mixed HTTP/importer races per profile: eight route families with all-queued and HTTP-first schedules plus row-waiting account deletion; distinct CLI/HTTP PIDs, SQL connections and engine waits. Genuine engine 40001/1213 once/exhaust and distinct HY000/1205 once/exhaust verify bounded atomic retries on both profiles. Prior L02d advisory-lock timeout remains separately attributed.

LB30.scope: Caller-managed first pair commits; invalid different pair is unchanged; first receipt survives. Each invocation is pair-atomic, no whole-batch success claim.

LB31.scope: Original domain refusal remains; restricted HTTP/importer identities cannot write genesis/epoch/certification or broaden permissions. Fixed-schema health routine with EXECUTE only admits proved native genesis; import target remains legacy_incomplete.

LB32.scope: Old committed receipt after actual account-deletion overlap returns metadata only, never revives sessions/privileges/content. PARTIAL: independent restore, inverse-SQL review and operational recovery remain NOT RUN.

LB33.scope: Rerun one creation/pending/approved observations, true actor/action/time and contradictory/missing-action checks.

status_scope: Only LB13/LB29 move PARTIAL to PASS; each other case retains its own unexecuted/review remainder. PASS is limited to the supported synthetic profile, not authentic production history.
